channel.description: EVENT OVERVIEW Event Name: Agentic AI Build Week & Hackathon Journey Date: July 25, 2026 Core Focus: Building smart native applications and Agentic AI solutions on the AWS platform. Objective: To provide an ultimate hands-on environment for engineers, developers, and junior solution architects to experience the design, development, and optimization of next-generation Artificial Intelligence (Agentic AI) systems on cloud computing. I. HACKATHON SPIRIT & EXPERIENCE OVERVIEW The event offered a practical and profound perspective on the 24-hour journey of continuous building, operating, and troubleshooting under high pressure.
